sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Customer_Addresses"."customer_id" AS e, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "Customer_Addresses" GROUP BY "Customer_Addresses"."customer_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS v FROM "s3") SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s3"."m1" AS REAL) / "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
why: share of the all total of number of Customer_Addresses records (all level)
index against the all average of number of Customer_Addresses records (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Departments"."dept_store_id" AS e, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "Departments" GROUP BY "Departments"."dept_store_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT SUM("s3"."m1") AS v FROM "s3") SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s3"."m1" AS REAL) / "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Supplier_Addresses"."supplier_id" AS e, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "Supplier_Addresses" GROUP BY "Supplier_Addresses"."supplier_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT SUM("s3"."m1") AS v FROM "s3") SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s3"."m1" AS REAL) / "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
why: gap to the all average of number of Supplier_Addresses records (all level)
share of the all total of number of Supplier_Addresses records (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Product_Suppliers"."supplier_id" AS e, AVG("Product_Suppliers"."total_value_purchased") AS m1 FROM "Product_Suppliers" GROUP BY "Product_Suppliers"."supplier_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS v FROM "s3") SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s3"."m1" AS REAL) / "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
why: average of value of product purchased per Suppliers (by supplier_id)
gap to the all average of average of value of product purchased (all level)
index against the all average of average of value of product purchased (all level)
